### Development mode (mock data)

Run with `--dart-define=ENVIRONMENT=dev` (default) for development configuration.

For production-like behavior without a backend:
```bash
flutter run --dart-define=ENVIRONMENT=dev
```



### Android emulator host

Use `--dart-define=API_HOST=10.0.2.2` when running on Android emulator.
API endpoints are defined in `lib/core/network/api_endpoints.dart`.

### Generated files

`*.g.dart` and `*.freezed.dart` files are generated — do not edit by hand.

- `*.g.dart` files are generated by `build_runner` for: `@riverpod`-annotated files (`riverpod_generator`), `@JsonSerializable` files (`json_serializable`).
- `*.freezed.dart` files are generated by `build_runner` for `@freezed`-annotated files (`freezed`).

Every file that contains a `@riverpod` annotation also declares `part '<filename>.g.dart';` at the top. Re-generate all generated files with:

```bash
# Run from project root
dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs
```

### Localization files

`app_localizations.dart`, `app_localizations_en.dart` and `app_localizations_es.dart` are generated by `flutter gen-l10n` from the `.arb` source files.

- Source files: `lib/l10n/app_en.arb` (English), `lib/l10n/app_es.arb` (Spanish)
- Generated files: `lib/l10n/app_localizations.dart`, `lib/l10n/app_localizations_en.dart`, `lib/l10n/app_localizations_es.dart`
- Regenerate with:

```bash
flutter gen-l10n
```

> Run `flutter gen-l10n` after modifying any `.arb` file or after cloning the project.

### Generated plugin registrants (desktop)

`generated_plugin_registrant.*` / `GeneratedPluginRegistrant.*` / `generated_plugins.cmake` files under `linux/`, `macos/` and `windows/` are generated by `flutter pub get` / `flutter build` — **do not version them**.

- Ignored in root `.gitignore` (desktop). iOS already ignores `Runner/GeneratedPluginRegistrant.*` via `ios/.gitignore`.
- Regenerated automatically on `flutter pub get` in CI and locally.
